skills.skill: Find the area of a parallelogram as base × height
Find the area of a triangle as base × height ÷ 2

misconceptions.pattern: Adds the base and height (or computes a perimeter) instead of multiplying them for the area of a parallelogram.
Computes base × height for a triangle and forgets to halve it (gives the whole parallelogram/rectangle area instead of half).

strategies.intent: A parallelogram shears into a rectangle of the same base and height, so its area is base × height — the slant side is not used.
A triangle is half of a rectangle with the same base and height, so find base × height and then halve it.
